scope: Integrate the frozen SW1, SW2, and SW3 role topology into the existing L1 planning and BranchUnit grammar data flow. This stage creates and validates role slots only; it does not generate role regions or optimize role curves.

planned_changes.purpose: Load the committed frozen role table by verified byte hash, validate its canonical topology digest, and materialize per-prototype independent L1 topology slots.
Attach the verified topology contract and topology slots to every formal L1 plan before geometry solving, without changing R1 curve generation.
Stop compiling the SW1 core wrap role as an L2 child and stop consuming the legacy SW3 forced-wrap channel.
Independently recompute family relations from slot level, parent, service flower, and prototype identity; assert every frozen R2A predicate and reject unsupported topologies.

anti_shortcut: No R1 threshold or motion-policy change.
No core role represented by an L2 or L3 descendant.
No implementation-emitted pass label is accepted as topology evidence.
